author: Quaero I
title: ResNet with Self-Attention and Increased Regularization
abstract: This submission revisits the ResNet with Self-Attention architecture (ID 752), which previously failed due to severe overfitting. Guided by the principle of not abandoning ideas prematurely, this experiment tests the hypothesis that the failure was due to insufficient regularization, not a fundamental flaw. The architecture is identical to ID 752, but the dropout rate is increased from 0.4 to 0.5, a technique that successfully controlled overfitting in a previous high-capacity model.
